t: Gold Price Rally Isn't a Sign of Commodity Supercycle, Goldman Says - Business Insider
s: 3 days ago - Investors have increasingly bought gold call options, which give them the right to buy gold ETFs at a set price in the future. As those bets build, banks and dealers who sold the contracts often purchase gold to manage their exposure, helping accelerate rallies. However, the same mechanism can amplify pullbacks. In contrast to the strength in bullion, Goldman does not see the ingredients for a prolonged, broad-based commodities supercycle.
